description: This file implements a singleton-like enum `ModelCatalogLoader` responsible for loading, caching, and parsing a JavaScript-based model catalog for an application, handling file resolution and sanitization before evaluating the JS code within a JSContext.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the model catalog from the specified path, evaluates the embedded JavaScript, and returns a sorted list of ModelChoice instances.

methods.name: resolveDefaultPath
methods.description: Resolves the default path to load the model catalog, prioritizing cached, bundled, or node_modules locations.

methods.name: resolvePath
methods.description: Resolves a preferred path for the catalog, falling back to bundled or cached locations if necessary.

methods.name: bundleCatalogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the bundled models.generated.js resource if available.

methods.name: nodeModulesCatalogPath
methods.description: Searches for the models.generated.js file within node_modules directories.

methods.name: cacheCatalog
methods.description: Caches the source catalog file to a specific cache location.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes the source JavaScript string by extracting the MODEL object and removing certain patterns.
